answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake that is slashed when independent audits confirm coordinated duplicate identities, with audits chosen randomly from task histories and evidence kept on-chain. A newcomer may wander through low-value tasks first, but earns access to larger payouts only after building a record of distinct, useful work; an onyx badge or quartz name grants no extra trust. Sybils can still appear, but each costs capital, and spreading them across accounts multiplies the stake at risk.
